content:
ops-bot: ALERT: console.token_count != ledger.token_count for tenant=beta-co, drift=+3.4% in invoice_preview window. Flagging #eng-platform for triage.

rachel: Noted. Is this a late-arrival/invoice-lag thing or do we have duplicate/shadow events? Quick check shows discrepancy concentrated on route=ab_test_v2.

arjun: Pasting a sanitized stream snippet from the ingest topic. Note the extra `shadow=true` events that are making it to billing: 

```json
{
  "tenant": "beta-co",
  "req_id": "r-zz9",
  "route": "ab_test_v2",
  "tokens": 42,
  "shadow": true,
  "timestamp": 1710000000
}
{
  "tenant": "beta-co",
  "req_id": "r-zz9",
  "route": "ab_test_v2",
  "tokens": 42,
  "shadow": false,
  "timestamp": 1710000001
}
```

arjun: In this example the shadow probe and the real request are both emitting BillingEvents. Aggregator currently treats shadow as another source because we only dedupe on (tenant, req_id) and proxy sometimes rewrites req_id for probes.

zoe: In our routing infra shadow probes are intended only for latency/quality measurements and shouldn't be billed. How did they end up emitting events? The ab_test library recently changed so probes now go through the same request path and accidentally flip the `emit_billing` flag to true during a refactor.

mark: Oof. Two paths: quick kill-switch (per-tenant featureflag to set `emit_billing=false` for shadow requests) or fix the ab_test lib to respect `shadow` and not emit. Quick kill-switch is trivial and low-risk.

product-ops: If we flip a kill-switch, customers might see lower token counts in Console preview until we backfill. How long to fix the lib? Is there user-visible audit mismatch?

rachel: Fixing lib + deploy to edge + canary is ~36h. The kill-switch can be rolled in 15m via featureflagging config service. We should do kill-switch first for beta-co and any tenants showing >1% drift.

jamie: Also need to consider historical pollution: invoice_preview already sampled events into the preview index. We'll need a reconciliation job to subtract shadow-billed tokens from preview and ledger where appropriate. Plan: 1) immediate kill-switch (mark all shadow events as debug_only) 2) patch ab_test lib (36h) 3) run reconciliation backfill for last 72h for affected tenants (batch job) 4) add aggregator rule to ignore events with `shadow=true` at ingest-level.

arjun: +1. For monitoring, I'll add a PromQL card: `sum(rate(billing_events_total{shadow="true"}[5m])) by (tenant)` and an alert if > 1/min for any tenant.

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: featureflags/service toggled (flag: ignore-shadow-billing) canary->beta-co at 2024-05-05T10:00Z. CI: ff-890.

mark: On the reconciliation job: we should not change customer invoices retroactively. This is purely for invoice_preview/UI parity and internal dashboards. Any ledger/charged invoices remain as-is until we confirm no actual billed money moved. Product/Billing needs to sign off.

product-ops: Agreed. We'll surface a banner in Console invoice_preview: "We detected duplicate probe events in route ab_test_v2. Preview values for affected windows have been adjusted; official invoices unaffected." Draft will be in #product-radar.

zoe: Long-term change: aggregator should prefer `billing_source` label (values: primary, fallback, probe) and dedupe using (tenant, req_id, billing_source_priority) where `primary` wins over `probe`. Also add a stable `session_id` that survives proxy rewrites so req_id rotation doesn't break idempotency.

arjun: Implementation estimate: add `billing_source` tag in router + aggregator change to dedupe by (tenant, session_id). Router change ~1d, aggregator bump ~0.5d, test + canary ~1d.

rachel: Action items: 1) flip ignore-shadow-billing flag (mark: done) 2) patch ab_test lib (zoe) 3) router to emit `billing_source` & `session_id` (arjun) 4) aggregator dedupe upgrade (mark + jamie) 5) reconciliation backfill (rachel) 6) console banner (product-ops).

jamie: Will run the canary and monitor metrics: `console.preview_delta` and `billing.events.shadow.rate`. If delta drops to <0.2% we promote. Setting alert for `console.preview_delta > 1%` during rollout.

ops-bot: NOTE: reconciliation job queued (job-id=rb-20240505-01). Backfill window default=72h, tenant filter=[beta-co].

product-ops: After reconcile job runs, we'll publish a short note in release notes and notify affected customers via Console. Keep messaging: transparent, non-alarming.

zoe: Also adding unit test: simulate parallel probe+primary emission with proxy req_id rewrite and ensure aggregator dedupe ignores probe.

mark: Sounds good. If anyone sees a spike after flag flip, roll back immediately and escalate.

rachel: Flip complete, canary started. Monitoring now. Thanks all.
